title: Spec 07 9.1: gateway translation of mesh-internal UDP ports mostly absent (5688/CAIP-2 nowhere; CoT-TCP-8087, Cayenne codec, NMEA, SenML bridges missing; only 5686-APRS-IS-TCP in Rust)
description: Spec 07 (spec/07-transport-app.md:47-64): 'Ports 5681, 5682, and 5685-5687 carry LICHEN-specific payload formats that may not have standard UDP port assignments elsewhere. These ports are mesh-internal: gateways MUST translate to standard protocols before forwarding traffic to external networks.' Translation table: 5681 to CoT XML over TCP 8087; 5682 to CoAP CF 112; 5685 to LoRaWAN app server; 5686 to APRS-IS TCP or AX.25 RF; 5687 to serial NMEA or CoAP/SenML; 5688 to chain-native RPC. Sweep R-07-001 classification: DIVERGENT - only 1 of 6 translations implemented. Evidence: (a) 5686 APRS-IS TCP implemented+tested: rust/lichen-gateway/src/aprs_is.rs AprsIsClient:228 login/send/recv :258-319, cot_to_aprs :473, aprs_to_cot :527, inline loopback-TCP tests :619-1072. (b) 5681 CoT XML: expansion functions only, no TCP 8087 listener in any stack (python/src/lichen/gateway/compact_cot.py:432 expand_cot_to_xml; compact_cot.py:765 compact_to_xml; rg 8087 clean). (c) 5682 SenML to CoAP CF112: constant+codec in all stacks (lichen/senml), no 5682-datagram-to-CoAP external bridge. (d) 5685 Cayenne: NO LPP codec in any stack (type codes 103/104/115/136 absent); port-dispatch enum only (rust/lichen-node/src/port_dispatch.rs:24-25, python/src/lichen/port_dispatch.py:38, lichen/subsys/lichen/udp_port_dispatch/udp_port_dispatch.c:42-44). (e) 5687 NMEA: no translation; Py sim only generates GGA/RMC (python/src/lichen/sim/gnss.py:100-156). (f) 5688 Crypto Relay: port 5688 absent from ALL constants/dispatch tables/vectors (rg 5688 clean in rust/ python/src lichen/ constants.toml); no CAIP-2 parsing, no CBOR keys 1/2/3 relay format (sweep rows R-07-019/020). Suggested placement: rust/lichen-gateway per-port forward module; python/src/lichen/gateway CoT TCP 8087 listener + Cayenne codec; port 5688 constant + dispatch entry first, then CAIP-2 relay; C apps/gateway only if the C gateway ships app translation.
